Analog–trend ensemble on log scale: persistence, damped 4-week trend, and same-weeks-of-prior-seasons analogs, weighted by past error using only outcomes known at each point in time. Intervals come from past errors in similar situations (level, recent trend, week of season), capped at the highest value seen in the same weeks of past seasons or 3× the median. Skill and coverage are scored out of sample.
